# stb_image

Unmodified upstream stb_image 2.30 header, commit `013ac3beddff3dbffafd5177e7972067cd2b5083`.
Source: [013ac3beddff3dbffafd5177e7972067cd2b5083](https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/013ac3beddff3dbffafd5177e7972067cd2b5083/stb_image.h).
SHA256: `594c2fe35d49488b4382dbfaec8f98366defca819d916ac95becf3e75f4200b3`.

Only JPEG decoding is compiled. The complete dual MIT/public-domain license
is retained in the header and in `docs/licenses/stb_image.txt`.
